text: and output format. Step t = 1 , … , N t=1,\dots,N . For any dialogue chunk D t D_{t} , the system executes the following three stages: (a) State Construction. Given a dialogue chunk D t D_{t} , set Input t ← D t , 𝒯 t − 1 \mathrm{Input}_{t}\leftarrow D_{t},\mathcal{T}_{t-1} . (b) Operation List Generation. Conditioned on ( D t , 𝒯 t − 1 , ℛ ) (D_{t},\mathcal{T}_{t-1},\mathcal{R}) , LLM outputs an operation list 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} , consisting of one or more atomic operations that strictly follow a predefined operation grammar. The operation types are limited to: ADD(path, value) : write descriptive text to the specified path; if the path does not exist, it may be created under an extended-schema policy; UPDATE(path, value) : perform an overwrite rewrite on the target leaf node, updating its text to the new value; DELETE(path, value) : clear the target leaf node or write a deletion marker to indicate that this type of information should be removed from long-term memory; NO_OP() : the current dialogue chunk does not contain stable core persona information that should be written to the PersonaTree. For update operations, our framework unifies them as rewrites of leaf strings. More importantly, potential conflicts between new and old information are resolved by LLM during the generation of 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} .
